metric: fixed-label [0,1] Macro F1 at a prespecified decision cutoff of 0.50
threshold_policy: No outer-label threshold tuning; C2_B logistic recipes use probability >= 0.50; DC_SVC uses LinearSVC margin >= 0 (expit(margin) is an uncalibrated monotone view).

availability_routing.stream_missing_expert: C1_B prediction reused from verified Round 1 cache
availability_routing.control: C4_HGB = C2_B when stream present, C1_B when blank/missing

fixed_base.structured_transform: C2_B Round 1 expanded structured preprocessing and fit-only transforms
fixed_base.word_tfidf: C2_B Round 1 frozen word TF-IDF parameters
fixed_base.logistic_regression: C2_B Round 1 frozen parameters unless recipe is DC_SVC

recipes.change: Replace LogisticRegression with sparse LinearSVC on the unchanged C2_B structured + word-TF-IDF + stream-missing design.
recipes.decision: Fixed decision margin 0. No calibration fit. expit(margin) only adapts the interface to a 0.50 probability-equivalent rule.

recipes.change: Multiply fit-only C2_B word TF-IDF columns by a smoothed L1-normalized document-presence log-count ratio, then fit the unchanged C2_B LogisticRegression.

parameters.normalization: L1 over each class's smoothed word-presence counts

recipes.scope: Ratio p_j=(df_positive,j+alpha)/sum_j(df_positive,j+alpha), q_j analogously; r_j=log(p_j)-log(q_j), learned from training-fold labels only. This is an NB-SVM-inspired weighted-TF-IDF + LR variant, not the literal binarized NB-SVM model in Wang and Manning (2012, P12-2018, Eq. 2). Structured columns and missing indicator are not reweighted.

recipes.change: Append a character TF-IDF block to the unchanged C2_B structured + word-TF-IDF + stream-missing design.

stage_1.retirement_gate: A candidate may be retired early only if it trails C4_HGB by at least 0.02 Macro F1 on both H12_E and H12_L. This is a triage rule, not a final selection rule.
stage_1.adaptive_development_warning: Cycles 56-79 have prior-use history. All results are adaptive development evidence, not independent holdout results or a generalization guarantee.

test_policy: The official Test is not read, fitted, scored, or predicted by this campaign lane. No Kaggle submissions are made.
